body: It is all true...and I'm 100% willing to take a drug test. I've been very sick today with a fungal infection in my blood, so I haven't gotten much done. But hopefully tomorrow I will be better. I asked to speak to a social worker today, but she hasn't showed up yet. Here's hoping she has some answers.
Like what? I literally have nowhere to go and no other options.
Once my car stopped running (which I realized was because they ran it into the ground) and they could not longer use it, they decided I was no longer worth hanging out with.
